items.source: Exception - in case of errors
items.translation: Exception - 在发生错误时

items.source: request - the current request
items.translation: request - 当前请求

items.source: deferredResult - the DeferredResult for the current request
items.translation: deferredResult - 当前请求的 DeferredResult

items.source: deferredResult - the DeferredResult for the current request; if the DeferredResult is set, then concurrent processing is resumed and subsequent interceptors are not invoked
items.translation: `deferredResult` - 当前请求的 DeferredResult；如果设置了 `DeferredResult`，则恢复并发处理，且不会调用后续的拦截器。

items.source: The handleTimeout method can set the DeferredResult in order to resume processing.
items.translation: ``handleTimeout` 方法可以设置 `DeferredResult` 以恢复处理。

items.source: A DeferredResultProcessingInterceptor is invoked before the start of async processing, after the DeferredResult is set as well as on timeout/error, or after completing for any reason including a timeout or network error.
items.translation: `DeferredResultProcessingInterceptor` 在异步处理开始之前被调用，此时 `DeferredResult` 已被设置；此外，在超时或出错时也会被调用，或在任何原因（包括超时或网络错误）导致完成之后被调用。

items.source: The DeferredResult may have already been set, for example at the time of its creation or by another thread.
items.translation: DeferredResult 可能已经被设置，例如在其创建时或由另一个线程设置。

items.source: This method may also be invoked after a timeout when the DeferredResult was created with a constructor accepting a default timeout result.
items.translation: 此方法在创建带有接受默认超时结果的构造器的`DeferredResult` 后，也可能在超时时被调用。

items.source: Invoked after a DeferredResult has been set, via DeferredResult.setResult(Object) or DeferredResult.setErrorResult(Object), and is also ready to handle the concurrent result.
items.translation: 在通过 DeferredResult.setResult(Object) 或 DeferredResult.setErrorResult(Object) 设置 DeferredResult 后调用，并且也已准备好处理并发结果。

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when an async request times out before the DeferredResult has been set. Implementations may invoke setResult or setErrorResult to resume processing.
items.translation: 当异步请求在 `DeferredResult` 被设置之前超时，且由容器线程调用时。实现可调用 setResult 或 setErrorResult 来恢复处理。

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when an error occurred while processing an async request before the DeferredResult has been set. Implementations may invoke setResult or setErrorResult to resume processing.
items.translation: 在异步请求处理期间，若 `DeferredResult` 尚未设置而发生了错误，则会在容器线程中调用此方法。实现可调用 setResult 或 setErrorResult 来恢复处理。

items.source: Invoked immediately before the start of concurrent handling, in the same thread that started it. This method may be used to capture state just prior to the start of concurrent processing with the given DeferredResult.
items.translation: 在并发处理的同一线程中，立即于其启动之前被调用。此方法可用于在给定 `DeferredResult` 的并发处理开始之前捕获状态。

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when an async request completed for any reason including timeout and network error. This method is useful for detecting that a DeferredResult instance is no longer usable.
items.translation: 当异步请求因任何原因（包括超时和网络错误）完成时，由容器线程调用。此方法可用于检测 `DeferredResult` 实例是否不再可用。

items.source: true if processing should continue, or false if other interceptors should not be invoked
items.translation: 如果应继续处理，则为 `true`；否则不应调用其他拦截器，则为 `false`。

items.source: true if error handling should continue, or false if other interceptors should be bypassed and not be invoked
items.translation: 如果错误处理应继续，则为 true；否则为 false，将跳过其他拦截器且不对其进行调用。

items.source: concurrentResult - the concurrent result
items.translation: concurrentResult - 并发结果

items.source: As a general rule exceptions raised by interceptor methods will cause async processing to resume by dispatching back to the container and using the Exception instance as the concurrent result. Such exceptions will then be processed through the HandlerExceptionResolver mechanism.
items.translation: 作为一般规则，拦截器方法抛出的异常将导致异步处理通过返回容器并使用该异常实例作为并发结果来恢复。随后，这些异常将通过 `<code>HandlerExceptionResolver`》机制进行处理。

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when an error occurred while processing an async request before the DeferredResult has been set.
items.translation: 在设置 `DeferredResult` 之前，如果在处理异步请求时发生错误，则会在容器线程中调用。

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when an async request times out before the DeferredResult has been set.
items.translation: 在异步请求超时且尚未设置 `DeferredResult` 时，由容器线程调用。

items.source:
Invoked from a container thread when an async request completed for any
reason including timeout and network error.
items.translation: 由容器线程调用，当异步请求因任何原因（包括超时和网络错误）完成时。

items.source:
Invoked immediately before the start of concurrent handling, in the same
thread that started it.
items.translation: 在并发处理开始之前立即被调用，且在与启动该处理的同一线程中执行。

items.source:
Invoked immediately after the start of concurrent handling, in the same
thread that started it.
items.translation: 在并发处理的开始阶段立即被调用，且在与启动该处理相同的线程中执行。

items.source: t - the error that occurred while request processing
items.translation: t - 请求处理过程中发生的错误

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev, Rob Winch
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev，Rob Winch
